name: Great Bear Spirit
summary: In Moonglade, Dendrite Starblaze sends you to the Great Bear Spirit to learn about the bear’s nature. He believes your strength and intent are ready to be focused.

sections.title: A Lesson in Bear Nature
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze waits in Nighthaven, Moonglade, with a lesson in mind. He asks you to seek the Great Bear Spirit in the northwest and learn what it can share about the bear’s nature. When you have finished, return to Dendrite; he sees strength and intent in you, and says you can learn to focus both through the bear’s nature.

faq.q: Who sends me to the Great Bear Spirit?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven asks you to seek the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Where is the Great Bear Spirit?
faq.answer: The Great Bear Spirit is in northwestern Moonglade.

faq.q: What am I meant to learn?
faq.answer: Dendrite asks you to learn what the Great Bear Spirit has to share about the nature of the bear.
After speaking with the Great Bear Spirit, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

attribution: In-game quest text: Great Bear Spirit
